text:
alex: who's up for a low-key Saturday? thinking pancakes + park walk in the morning, then board games at my place in the evening. anyone? :pancakes: :game_die:

mina: pancakes yes. what time for the walk? kids soccer at 11 so i could do 9-10:30ish.

jorge: i'd be down for games later. can bring Betrayal at House on the Hill or Codenames. also have a 6-person expansion for Dixit.

rachel: 9:30 walk works. i'll bring coffee thermos and lemon bars (vegan).

alex: plan: meet at riverside bench near the big maple at 9:15, 30-45min loop, back by ~10. drop by house for games 7pm. BYOB snacks encouraged.

kate: timing perfect  will be free after a morning run. can bring a pitcher of sparkling water and chips.

mina: alex any dietary restrictions? i'm bringing GF pancake mix, can make both.

alex: no gluten requirement here, but GF option is great, thank you. also got one coffee maker that needs directions if someone wants to run it :laughing:

jorge: i can handle the coffee operation. pro tip: heat water to just under boiling.

rachel: also bringing a small potted basil if anyone wants a cutting later. it's very prolific. :herb:

alex: ooh plant swap! i have a spider plant cutting i can bring.

calendar-bot: Reminder: Jorge 10:00 AM parents meeting on Sunday (added earlier).

mina: quick logistics question: parking near the park? is the lot usually full?

alex: usually fine early. street parking along elm is free on weekends, but bring change for meter near the cafe if you plan to stay longer.

jorge: re: games, does anyone have a 3-player compromise option if we get a small group? i'm partial to Pandemic for co-op.

rachel: Pandemic is great. or we could do Team Trivial Pursuit if people want low setup.

kate: i'll text before to confirm final headcount. see you Saturday! :wave:

alex: perfect. recap: meet riverside bench @9:15, 30-45min walk, pancakes + GF option, games at my place 7pm, bring snacks/plant cuttings if you want. cheers!
